name: Premium Angled Feather Flags
descriptionHtml:
Capture attention from every direction with our Premium Angled Flags, designed for high-impact branding at trade shows, outdoor events, storefronts, festivals, and canopy setups. The angled shape creates a bold visual flow that naturally attracts attention and increases brand visibility.

Available in 9ft, 12ft, and 15ft heights, all flags are double-sided by default, ensuring your message is seen from both sides. Your artwork is printed using high-resolution full-color dye sublimation on durable knitted polyester fabric for vibrant, long-lasting results.

Each flag comes standard with a cross base and water bag, making it ideal for both indoor and outdoor use. For added versatility, you can upgrade to ground stakes or a mounting kit, allowing the flag to be securely mounted directly to a canopy tent.

Built with strong yet flexible fiberglass poles, these flags are engineered to perform reliably in various environments while remaining lightweight and easy to transport.

🔹 Key Features

🚩 Angled Flag Design – Dynamic shape for maximum visibility
📏 Available Sizes – 9ft, 12ft, and 15ft heights
🔁 Double-Sided Printing Included – Standard on all flags
🎨 Full-Color Dye Sublimation – Sharp, fade-resistant printing
💪 Fiberglass Poles – Lightweight, flexible, and durable
⚓ Base Included – Cross base + water bag included by default
🏕️ Multiple Mounting Options – Upgrade to ground stakes or canopy mounting kit
🧳 Portable & Easy Setup – Fast assembly for events and promotions

🔹 Imprint Method

🖨️ Full-Color Dye Sublimation

🔹 Materials

🧵 Graphic / Flag: Knitted Polyester
🦾 Hardware: 100% Epoxy Fiberglass
🎒 Carry Case: 600 Denier Polyester

🔹 Primary Usage

Trade shows, outdoor events, canopy tents, vendor booths, storefront advertising, festivals, promotions, and brand activations.

Warranty

We stand behind the quality of our products. Our warranty covers any factory defects or damage that occurs during shipping. However, please note that we do not cover damage resulting from extreme weather conditions, misuse, or any circumstances beyond our control.
